articles.title: How deep can a shark go?
articles.summary: Sharks exhibit remarkable diving capabilities, with various species reaching surprising depths into the ocean's twilight and even abyssal zones. The precise maximum depth achievable differs significantly among species, showcasing their adaptability to extreme pressure environments. This discovery challenges prior understandings of shark habitat ranges, highlighting their incredible resilience and capacity to thrive in diverse deep-sea conditions.
